recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR-39268 follow-up is needed unless a future work-group decision replaces the per-resource versionAlgorithm mechanism.
issue_request: FHIR-39268 was a Published FHIR-I R5 change request resolved Not Persuasive with Modification. It proposed moving versionAlgorithm semantics above individual canonical resources, such as to ImplementationGuide or a Library-context extension; the approved resolution instead kept the mechanism on CanonicalResource and required a note acknowledging the compromise.
initial_application: Git commit 52c9f20f1274e97692621a3513bd13104cf52296 added the Version Comparison section and implementer note to source/canonicalresource/canonicalresource-notes.xml for FHIR-39268. Commit e4294d8526f3da840ea9d27ba04208bf3ffd3bea corrected the wording while preserving the approved meaning.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists canonicalresource as an active infrastructure interface and keeps CanonicalResource in the normative infrastructure package. FHIR-I WGM minutes confirm the rationale that many canonical resources exist outside IGs and are not referenced by Libraries, and a Zulip thread discussed the same note language while separating the trial-use marking issue that became FHIR-40493. Later FHIR-52932 refined versionAlgorithm code-system entries but did not supersede the FHIR-39268 note.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/canonicalresource/canonicalresource-notes.xml already contains the Version Comparison section and implementer note explaining that each resource version claiming its own comparison mechanism is clunky but was the best committee-identified solution that works in all circumstances.

related_jiras.note: Created from the same FHIR-I follow-up to mark net-new R5 elements as trial use; it explains the status discussion but is separate from the FHIR-39268 note.
